Method of Attack: Exploiting a vulnerability in sudo's get_process_ttyname() function allowing an attacker to create malformed sudo commands to overwrite any file on the system, including root-owned files, thereby gaining root privileges
Local user can pretend that his tty is any character device on the filesystem and after race conditions can pretend that his tty is any file on the filesystem
On SELinux-enabled systems, relabel_tty() calls open and dup2 on the tty to redirect command's stdin, stdout, and stderr allowing privilege escalation
Impacted Systems: Linux distros with sudo built with SELinux support enabled, including Red Hat, SUSE, Debian, Ubuntu
Attack Vector: Local attacker able to run bash commands and execute malformed sudo commands exploiting the vulnerability in sudo with SELinux enabled
